acceptance: No fmt.Sprintf of an ./acs/cycle pattern remains in internal/acssuite outside CyclePackage

consumed.resolution: The seam branch (discoverGoLane) calls CyclePackage, and TestCyclePackage_NoOtherCodeInThePackageSpellsACyclePattern fails on any ./acs/cycle literal outside CyclePackage in the package (go/internal/acssuite/acssuite.go).

summary: go/internal/acssuite/acssuite.go:358 defines CyclePackage as the ONE spelling of a cycle's predicate package so the writer and its readers cannot drift, yet runGoTest's seam-mode branch (acssuite.go:436) builds the same pattern with fmt.Sprintf("./acs/cycle%d", opts.Cycle). Identical output today; a change to CyclePackage would silently leave seam mode on the old spelling. Found by the round-10 comment editor (not fixed in a comment-only PR).
title: acssuite's seam-mode branch spells ./acs/cycle%d by hand instead of calling CyclePackage, the package's one documented spelling
